scene_description: A spruce plank greenhouse building located 4-8 blocks from spawn, containing a sugar cane farm (sand + water + 3 double-tall sugar cane plants). The building has a spruce door entrance on the south face with glass pane windows flanking it, a glass ceiling for natural lighting, and stone brick flooring. A small cobblestone decoy structure with an oak door is placed to the west as a distractor. The player must first find the spruce door on the greenhouse, then enter to discover the sugar cane growing inside.
